records: Ofcom's complaints report page was last updated on 30 July 2026.
The latest complaints quarter covers January to March 2026.
Overall complaints to Ofcom decreased from Q4 2025 to Q1 2026.
Fixed-broadband complaints decreased quarter on quarter in Q1 2026.
Pay-monthly mobile complaints decreased quarter on quarter in Q1 2026.
Landline complaints stayed at the same overall level quarter on quarter in Q1 2026.
Pay-TV complaints stayed at the same overall level quarter on quarter in Q1 2026.
Overall complaints had returned to all-time-low levels in Q1 2026.
Broadband complaints reached an all-time low of six per 100,000 customers in Q1 2026.
The historic broadband-complaint peak cited by Ofcom was 40 per 100,000 customers in 2011.
TalkTalk was the most complained-about fixed-broadband provider in Q1 2026.
TalkTalk's broadband complaint level was similar to the previous quarter.
Plusnet and Sky generated the fewest fixed-broadband complaints.
Plusnet and TalkTalk generated the most landline complaints.
Both Plusnet and TalkTalk saw their landline complaint rates increase from the previous quarter.
Sky Mobile generated the most pay-monthly mobile complaints.
Sky Mobile's complaints were primarily driven by experiences changing provider.
EE and Virgin Media generated the most pay-TV complaints.
EE's leading pay-TV complaint driver was complaints handling.
Virgin Media's leading pay-TV complaint driver was billing, pricing and charges.
Fixed-broadband results for Plusnet and Sky were considered comparable.
